items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: the headline had a picture of Stan Getz robbing a drugstore

ctx.x: Yeah, this was on radio. Live radio show. Yeah, it was incredible. And then we started doing these television shows and I remember one television show we did had Liston Johnson. Do you know who Liston is? Liston is like just a legend in himself, man. I mean, he's been around for so many years. He's one of those early people who came to New Orleans and absorbed the culture and stayed here and, I mean, was a fixture at the Fairmont for how many years, man?
